decisions: Keep the implementation within the incumbent Taskplane 2.19.0 Python modules, RunStore, filesystem artifacts, lifecycle, graph, wiring, delivery-port, and validation capabilities; the current requirement supplies no repo-grounded merit case for a new external dependency, service, vendor, or coordination layer.

Treat native-host/version selection as a bounded capability and contract decision against the installed 2.19.0 engine, not as authority to introduce a remote orchestration service or duplicate an incumbent owner.

If a later Design proposal adds a dependency or service, require an explicit incumbent-gap case plus licence and distribution compatibility, operational ownership, bounded transitive footprint, lock-in and exit seam, historical compatibility, rollback, and removal of any newly redundant incumbent before approval.
